title: Will iPhones Ever Get Rid Of USB-C Charging Ports? - BGR
summary: After all, MagSafe and Qi2 are viable wireless charging technologies that could potentially replace charging cables. As we've established, however, it's not about USB-C: rather, the commission has appointed a panel that's looking into selecting a wireless charging standard.
